strings.@description: Compress files and folders into .zip archives and extract them, from the menu of files and folders (Compress → Zip or Unzip).
strings.@entrypoints.work.label: Compress and extract
strings.@menus.zip.compress.label: Compress
strings.@actions.zip.zip.label: Zip
strings.@actions.zip.unzip.label: Unzip
strings.archive.name: Archive
strings.main.intro: To make an archive, open the menu of files or folders and choose Compress → Zip. To extract one, choose Compress → Unzip, or open the .zip file to see what is inside.
strings.main.limits: Archives and the files in them can be up to {limit} each.
strings.error.tooMany: Too many files: at most {max} in one archive
strings.error.tooBig: Too much data at once: at most {detail}
strings.error.resultTooBig: The archive would be {detail}: lilOS saves files up to {limit}
strings.error.corrupt: This is not a valid .zip archive ({detail})
strings.error.outside: The item is outside your home

strings.@description: Comprime file e cartelle in archivi .zip e li estrae, dal menu di file e cartelle (Comprimi → Zip o Unzip).
strings.@entrypoints.work.label: Comprime ed estrae
strings.@menus.zip.compress.label: Comprimi
strings.@actions.zip.zip.label: Zip
strings.@actions.zip.unzip.label: Unzip
strings.archive.name: Archivio
strings.main.intro: Per creare un archivio apri il menu di file o cartelle e scegli Comprimi → Zip. Per estrarne uno scegli Comprimi → Unzip, oppure apri il file .zip per vedere cosa contiene.
strings.main.limits: Gli archivi e i file che contengono arrivano a {limit} ciascuno.
strings.error.tooMany: Troppi file: al massimo {max} in un archivio
strings.error.tooBig: Troppi dati in una volta: al massimo {detail}
strings.error.resultTooBig: L'archivio sarebbe di {detail}: lilOS salva file fino a {limit}
strings.error.skippedAll: In «{detail}» non c'è niente che si possa estrarre
strings.error.outside: L'elemento è fuori dalla tua home
